subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — pricing path and approval
messages:
From: Jonathan Gray <jonathan.gray@stratushealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP for pilot + ask on evaluation pricing

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. StratusHealth is interested in running a 60-day evaluation focused on our clinical summarization workflow. Our procurement and clinical leads want a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties milestone acceptance to commercial terms — specifically an evaluation discount that steps down to full price on commit/ramp.

High-level asks from our side:
- 60-day evaluation starting Jan 4 (target) with three milestones (data ingest, clinical quality signoff, performance/ramp test)
- Requesting a 20% evaluation discount for the 60-day window, to convert to a 12-month commitment with stepped pricing thereafter
- Need SOW + MAP by Dec 10 for procurement review; we have an internal procurement window the week of Dec 14

Can you share a MAP draft and confirm whether a 20% evaluation discount is doable? If not, what approval path would you need internally and what conditions (commit size, ramp) should we expect?

Attachments: Stratus_MAP_requirements.pdf (details from the clinical team)

Best,
Jonathan
Jonathan Gray
Head of Partnerships, StratusHealth
jonathan.gray@stratushealth.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonathan Gray <jonathan.gray@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Alyssa Mercer <alyssa.mercer@stratushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP for pilot + ask on evaluation pricing

Jonathan — thanks for the clear asks and timeline. Happy to run with this.

I've attached a draft MAP and a provisional SOW that maps the three milestones to acceptance criteria and deliverables. Proposal summary:
- 60-day eval window (target start Jan 4)
- Conditional evaluation pricing: 20% off list for evaluation period, subject to internal approval.
- Conversion terms: 12-month minimum commitment on conversion; ramp schedule and committed monthly minimum to be included in SOW.
- Required approvals: VP Sales + Finance (CFO) sign-off for discounts >15% — I'll route internally.

Next steps from our side: I will escalate the 20% request through our approval chain and aim to get an internal response by Dec 4 so we can hit your Dec 10 target for SOW delivery. If finance needs a commitment floor, I'll propose a 12-month $150k ARR minimum (flexible if you provide expected post-conversion volume).

Attachments: Stratus_MEP_MAP_draft.pdf, SOW-Stratus-v1.docx

Appreciate the pace — I'll loop in my manager and finance for sign-off.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Lauren — forwarding the ask from StratusHealth. Quick summary: they want a 60-day eval with a 20% discount for the eval period and a conversion to a 12-month commitment afterwards. Procurement needs SOW + MAP by Dec 10.

What I need from you and finance:
- Can we approve a 20% eval discount for a pilot that converts to a 12-month $150k ARR commit?
- If not, what discount floor can we offer without additional executive sign-off?
- Any required legal/contract language we should include in the MAP to lock the conversion timeline?

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7832 (estimate and proposed SOW attached)

Thanks — trying to keep momentum and hit their procurement window.

-- Karthik
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP for pilot + ask on evaluation pricing — StratusHealth (DEAL-7832)

Team — quick read: Stratus is strategic (healthcare vertical, strong refs) but the 20% eval discount is above our usual floor. My recommendation: finance sign-off required for anything >15% unless we get a larger commit/shorter conversion timeline.

Potential counter: approve 18% for the eval if Stratus commits to a 12-month term and a minimum monthly usage (we should ask for expected token/embedding volumes). Alternatively, cap the discount at 15% and offer an incentive-based ramp credit tied to their milestone acceptance (e.g., extra one-off credit applied after clinical quality signoff).

Neha — can you run the numbers on an 18% vs 15% evaluation discount with a $150k ARR baseline and share any P&L concerns? Vivek — if higher discount required, will need your sign-off (or Evelyn for exceptional cases).

— Lauren
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP pricing sensitivity — StratusHealth (DEAL-7832)

Folks — I ran a baseline on the proposed structure. Key points:
- 20% eval discount is dilutive at the $150k ARR baseline unless we get a firm commit + minimum monthly usage. At 20% we'd need a 12-month guarantee with net-new revenue or a signed LOI to mitigate churn risk.
- 18% is acceptable to finance provided Stratus signs a 12-month commitment with a minimum monthly spend of $12.5k for the first 3 months post-conversion, and that we include a clawback clause if they terminate within 6 months of conversion.
- 15% is preferred (lower risk) and can be approved without CFO escalation.

I'll attach a quick model (pricing-model-stratus.xlsx) showing expected gross margin across scenarios. If Sales can secure the 12-month LOI or increase the commit floor, we can approve up to 18% for the eval period.

— Neha
Attachment: pricing-model-stratus.xlsx
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP pricing sensitivity — StratusHealth (DEAL-7832)

Thanks Neha — I agree with finance's tradeoffs. I'm comfortable approving an 18% evaluation discount conditional on:
- Signed LOI or contract that includes 12-month term and the $12.5k minimum monthly for the first 3 months post-conversion, and
- A clawback if they terminate <6 months after conversion, and
- Legal signs off on the MAP language that pins milestone acceptance and conversion triggers.

Evelyn — tagging for awareness; this is within the normal approval path but I can escalate to you if anything exceptional arises.

If Sales can get the LOI/commit in writing before Dec 10, we should be able to deliver SOW + MAP to their procurement on time.

— Vivek
